info.name: Space Sim Tiles Demo
info.description: Tiled orbital-flight demo and scale/handling comparison: 2×, 4× and 8× worlds with a physical 5 m survey lander, static human references and Primus/Parvus landing areas. Four times is provisional.

definition.name: Successor scale comparison
definition.description: Development comparison of 2×, 4× and 8× Classic celestial scale. Fixed-mu gravity, one human-scale lander and short surface routes. Choose final scale and handling after playtesting.
definition.author: Space Sim Team

systems.name: 4× Classic · Primus System (provisional)
systems.description: 4× scale trial, unchanged mu and mass. Survey lander: 5 m across, 24 m/s² maximum thrust. Arrow Up/Down for throttle (Ctrl for fine control), Space for engine; A/D to turn. Scroll to zoom; C for planet view. Compare launch, orbit and landing; 4× is provisional. Primus and Parvus: 1.8 m static reference by the pad, Ridge Lookout 140 m east and Basin Station 220 m west. No EVA controls in this trial.
